name: Rikkig
description: One of the Shattergang Brothers, a goblin bomb-maker who holds prisoners and escapes Gideon.

timeline.summary: Gideon storms the Shattergang hideout, fights Rikkig and survives his bomb; Rikkig escapes while Gideon and Dars free prisoners.
timeline.quote: "The Boros didn't take Krenko. I did. Just like I got your brother. And now I'm here for you."

relations.quote: "You're not safe to do anything, Rikkig, unless you come with me right now."

pages_say.description: One of the Shattergang Brothers, a goblin bomb-maker who holds prisoners and escapes Gideon.
